text:
Why Claude Code has to release new version multiple times within a day?
Can't they simply release once a week, test and QA the code well before releasing.

author.name: Christopher Fortin
author.headline: Founder, SVP Strategic Development at 5Seams, Inc.

comments.text: Also because we are the testers. They don't want a week to find out an update broke it.

author.name: Christopher Fortin

comments.text: You pay the time price to be on the bleeding edge.
